description: This pie chart visually represents data categorized by year, with three distinct slices corresponding to 2017, 2018, and 2019, each labeled with its respective year and numerical value in parentheses. The 2019 slice, colored blue, occupies the largest portion of the chart and is labeled with the value (46) but lacks a percentage label. The 2018 slice, colored orange, is the second largest and is explicitly labeled as 33.0% (33). The 2017 slice, colored green, is the smallest and is labeled as 21.0% (21). The chart includes a legend indicating that the blue slice corresponds to 2019, the orange slice to 2018, and the green slice to 2017. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, with 2019 at the top, followed by 2018 on the left, and 2017 on the right. No slices are visually emphasized through explosion or bolding.
